name: bruenor battlehammer
lore:
To understand Bruenor Battlehammer, one must look to the deep veins of the Spine of the World. A shield dwarf of legendary stubbornness, he is an apex creature of the subterranean forge, fueled by potent ale and the rhythmic chime of hammer on mithral. His behavior is marked by a gruff, gravelly pragmatism; he speaks little, preferring to act with the sudden, crushing force of a rockslide.

In his natural habitat—the echoing vaults of Mithral Hall—he is both king and laborer, his red beard stained by soot and his hands calloused by centuries of craft. While he displays a territorial ferocity toward invaders, he exhibits a fierce, paternal loyalty to his "kin," a pack bond that transcends race. To encounter him is to confront the mountain itself: unyielding, weathered by a thousand storms, and utterly immovable.
